p1.title: https://rwnewyork.com/rws-next-chapter/resorts-world-new-york-city-cirrus-unveil-new-agreement-to-build-up-to-50000-units-of-workforce-housing/
p1.excerpt: Resorts World New York City has officially formed a joint venture with Cirrus to invest in this housing commitment, which will focus on large-scale projects across the five boroughs. The new partnership will begin to invest in new housing developments in the immediate term.

p2.title: https://rwnewyork.com/rws-next-chapter/resorts-world-new-york-city-cirrus-unveil-new-agreement-to-build-up-to-50000-units-of-workforce-housing/
p2.excerpt: To meet this need, Resorts World has made a down payment to build fair housing in a multi-million-dollar commitment not just for its employees but all working-class New Yorkers.

p7.title: https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/
p7.excerpt: Workforce Housing Fund LANDMARK JOINT VENTURE WITH ORGANIZED LABOR We aim to tackle the city’s affordability crisis head-on by delivering the largest injection of new workforce housing in decades. We are creating up to 50,000 units citywide that are union-financed and union-built. $25M Annually $25M Delivered in 2026 Data as of September 2026

p8.title: https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/
p8.excerpt: Community Commitments We're investing in the places we call home. We’re putting real dollars behind real promises with meaningful community development in Queens because we’re more than just a business. We are a trusted community partner with purpose that continues to keep its promises.

p11.title: https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/workforce-housing/
p11.excerpt: POWERED BY RESORTS WORLD'S $750M DIRECT INVESTMENT

p12.title: https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/workforce-housing/
p12.excerpt: Resorts World's Workforce Housing Initiative, funded through the Cirrus Workforce Housing Fund, is a landmark partnership with organized labor to deliver tens of thousands of new homes for working families across New York City.

p13.title: https://rwnewyork.com/community/community-investments/workforce-housing/
p13.excerpt: About 700 new homes could be coming to Downtown Jamaica on the site of what’s now a massive parking garage, as part of the agreement by Resorts World New York City and Cirrus Real Estate Partners to deliver nearly 50,000 units across the five boroughs. The joint venture has purchased the 1.8-acre development site and parking garage at 92-30 165th St. for $46.1 million with plans to turn the lot into housing, according to Cirrus and Ripco Real Estate, which brokered the deal.
